text: Mobile app development is an exciting field today. When building an app, developers must consider responsive design so the layout works well on different screen sizes. They also choose between native development, which is faster and uses device features fully, or cross-platform tools, which save time by sharing code across systems. After development, apps are published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where users can download them. Performance matters a lot: a slow app frustrates users and gets poor reviews. Therefore, developers test carefully to keep apps smooth, reliable, and enjoyable for everyone.
